anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
No recent learning cycles or opportunities generated by AI, suggesting potential issues with AI functionality or configuration.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss, which is unusual for an active trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage by identifying and resolving bottlenecks or distributing workloads more evenly.
Enhance AI module to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Review and potentially adjust active trading strategies to ensure they are aligned with current market conditions.

recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of CPU-intensive processes and consider scaling resources or optimizing code to reduce load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Review AI system logs and configurations to diagnose why no learning cycles or opportunities are being generated.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform competitiveness.

recommendations.action: Evaluate the current trading strategies and market conditions to ensure strategies are effective and relevant.
recommendations.rationale: Inactive trading and zero profit/loss suggest strategies may not be engaging with the market effectively.
